tooltip.fras.wooden_shaft.details: Needs a support every 8 blocks. Place it against a face to lay it along that face's axis.
tooltip.fras.bearing: Supports a shaft line. Max torque 128 Nm.
tooltip.fras.bearing.details: Hangs on a sturdy face, a fence, a wall, iron bars or a chain above. Right-click it onto a shaft to swap it in.
tooltip.fras.clutch.details: Engaging two lines turning opposite ways jams it.
tooltip.fras.pulley: Max 96 RPM. Link two with a leather belt.
tooltip.fras.pulley.details: A belt carries at most 24 Nm and slips above that. Not a support.
tooltip.fras.large_pulley: Max 96 RPM. Twice a pulley's size: a 2:1 ratio.
tooltip.fras.large_pulley.details: Needs the 8 blocks around it in its plane clear. Not a support.
tooltip.fras.wooden_bevel_gear: Max 56 RPM. Turns the line by 90°.
tooltip.fras.wooden_bevel_gear.details: The wrench moves the output to the face you click, or toggles a T (a second output).
tooltip.fras.iron_bevel_gear: Max 192 RPM. Turns the line by 90°.
tooltip.fras.iron_bevel_gear.details: The wrench moves the output to the face you click, or toggles a T (a second output).
tooltip.fras.gearbox: 2:1. Max 192 RPM on its fast side.
tooltip.fras.gearbox.details: The large box's face turns half as fast with twice the torque. The wrench flips it, and so does a redstone signal coming or going.
tooltip.fras.crank: Hold right-click to turn it. Sneak to turn it the other way.
tooltip.fras.crank.details: 16 Nm at a standstill, up to 32 RPM. Cranking makes you hungry.
tooltip.fras.water_wheel: Turns in flowing water. Up to 32 Nm, 24 RPM.
tooltip.fras.water_wheel.details: 8 Nm for each flowing water block among its paddles; falling water on top counts double.
tooltip.fras.grinder: Works between 12 and 96 RPM, with a 6 Nm load.
tooltip.fras.grinder.details: Grinds: raw ores (×1.5), raw ore blocks, cobblestone, gravel, wool, bones. Raw ore only: mine ore blocks first.
tooltip.fras.tachometer: Shows the speed of the part it is on. Right-click for the number and the last minute.
tooltip.fras.tachometer.details: Red above the red line, yellow below the machines' minimum. Comparator: 0 to 15 up to the red line.
tooltip.fras.wrench: Configures and repairs parts. Sneak to inspect.
tooltip.fras.leather_belt: Right-click two pulleys to link them.
tooltip.fras.leather_belt.details: Parallel axes, in one plane, at most 16 blocks apart. One belt per 4 blocks.
tooltip.fras.hand_hammer: Hammers ingots into plates in the crafting grid.
fras.wrench.no_other_mount: Nothing else can hold this bearing
fras.wrench.crossed: Belt crossed: the pulleys turn opposite ways
fras.wrench.open: Belt open: the pulleys turn the same way
fras.inspect.not_connected: Not part of a network yet
fras.inspect.paused: Paused: part of this network is outside the simulated area
fras.inspect.slipping: Belt slipping: it carries at most %s Nm, the driven side needs more
fras.inspect.stalled: Stalled: load %s Nm, sources give %s Nm
fras.inspect.load: Load %s%%: drawing %s Nm, sources give %s Nm
fras.inspect.span_sag: Span %s, needs a support every %s: sagging
fras.belt.not_parallel: The pulleys' axes must be parallel
fras.belt.not_in_plane: The pulleys must be side by side in one plane
fras.belt.taken: This pulley already has a belt
tooltip.fras.copper_boiler.details: Blocks touching face to face form one boiler if they fill a cuboid. Needs a steam dome on top and a firebox below or beside its bottom layer.
tooltip.fras.iron_boiler.details: Blocks touching face to face form one boiler if they fill a cuboid. Doesn't join copper boiler blocks: leave a gap.
tooltip.fras.storage_tank: Holds water or steam. Up to 27 blocks.
tooltip.fras.storage_tank.details: Blocks touching face to face form one tank if they fill a cuboid. Rated 6 bar with steam. Buckets fill and empty it.
tooltip.fras.steam_dome: Lets steam out of a boiler: 100 mB/s.
tooltip.fras.steam_dome.details: Place it on top of a boiler. A boiler without one is sealed and bursts when heated.
tooltip.fras.firebox: Burns any fuel. Heats boilers above or beside it.
tooltip.fras.firebox.details: Coal gives 1000 kW. Hoppers fill it from the top and sides.
tooltip.fras.copper_pipe.details: One content per network: water or steam. The wrench connects or cuts the face you click.
tooltip.fras.iron_pipe.details: One content per network: water or steam. The wrench connects or cuts the face you click.
tooltip.fras.manual_valve.details: Right-click opens it a step, sneaking closes it. Closed, it splits the network in two. Carries 200 mB/s open.
tooltip.fras.redstone_valve.details: Closed unpowered, like a door. Carries 200 mB/s open.
tooltip.fras.steam_release: Right-click to vent steam: up to 80 mB/s.
tooltip.fras.steam_release.details: Goes on a pipe end, a dome or a tank. The jet scalds 2 blocks out.
tooltip.fras.emergency_valve: Opens at its set pressure: up to 80 mB/s.
tooltip.fras.emergency_valve.details: Set half a bar under the red line when placed. The wrench changes it in 0.5 bar steps.
tooltip.fras.pump: Draws 25 mB/s per water source it touches.
tooltip.fras.pump.details: Works between 8 and 128 RPM with a 4 Nm load. The outlet is opposite the shaft.
tooltip.fras.steam_cylinder: Stall 16 Nm per bar, top 32 RPM per bar.
tooltip.fras.steam_cylinder.details: Place it two blocks beside a flywheel's hub, facing it. The wrench on the flywheel reverses the engine.
tooltip.fras.flywheel: A 3×3 iron wheel. Smooths a line.
tooltip.fras.flywheel.details: Needs the 8 blocks around its hub clear. With a steam cylinder it makes an engine.
tooltip.fras.pressure_gauge: Shows the pressure of the part it is on. Right-click for the number and the last minute.
tooltip.fras.pressure_gauge.details: 0 to 8 bar; the red line is marked. Comparator: 0 to 15 up to the red line.
tooltip.fras.sight_glass: Shows the water in a boiler or tank. Right-click for the number and the last minute.
tooltip.fras.sight_glass.details: Yellow when a boiler is below 25%, red below 10%. Comparator: 0 to 15 with the water.
fras.settings.explosion.tooltip: What a burst boiler does to the world. Full: blocks break. Contained: only the boiler breaks. Off: the boiler is only damaged.
fras.wrench.still_blocked: Clear the blocks around the wheel first
fras.wrench.pipe_nothing: Nothing to connect to on this face
fras.wrench.pipe_mix: Water and steam can't share a network
fras.inspect.partial: Part of this plant is outside the loaded area
fras.inspect.plant_paused: Paused: part of this plant is outside the simulated area
fras.inspect.not_cuboid: Not a cuboid: fill the gaps or remove the extra blocks
fras.inspect.no_dome: No steam dome: steam can't get out, heating it will burst it
fras.inspect.warning_timer: Over the red line: bursts in %s s
fras.inspect.steam_flow: Capacity %s mB/bar, steam in %s mB/s, out %s mB/s
fras.inspect.heating_nothing: Heating nothing: put it below or beside a boiler's bottom layer
fras.inspect.pump_idle: No water, or the outlet is full
fras.inspect.engine: Engine: stall %s Nm, top %s RPM, %s cylinder(s)
fras.inspect.no_flywheel: No flywheel: place it two blocks beside a flywheel's hub, facing it
tooltip.fras.governor: Throttles the steam to the engines downstream. Right-click to set target and sensitivity.
tooltip.fras.governor.details: Put it in a steam pipe and turn its socket from the engine's shaft. Target 8 to 192 RPM; higher sensitivity holds speed tighter but can hunt.
tooltip.fras.furnace_damper: Turns the fire down as pressure nears its setting. Redstone shuts it.
tooltip.fras.furnace_damper.details: Place it on a boiler. The wrench sets the pressure, 1 to 8 bar. All shut banks the fire.
tooltip.fras.bellows: Blows a firebox: up to 50% more heat from the same fuel.
tooltip.fras.bellows.details: Place it against a firebox and turn it: 16 to 128 RPM, full boost at 64 RPM. One per firebox.
tooltip.fras.heat_exchanger: Condenses exhaust into hot water, or cools hot water. Radiators and waterlogging help.
tooltip.fras.heat_exchanger.details: 250 kW in air, 500 kW waterlogged, plus up to 4 radiators. One fully fitted, waterlogged exchanger handles one firebox.
tooltip.fras.iron_radiator: +75 kW on a heat exchanger. Rusts.
tooltip.fras.drain: Dumps water or hot water nothing else takes.
tooltip.fras.rust_flakes: Scraped off rusted iron. Grind them into pigment.
tooltip.fras.red_oxide_pigment: Mix two with water for paint.
tooltip.fras.red_oxide_paint: Right-click a clean iron part. Eight parts around one tin paint all eight.
fras.settings.rust.tooltip: Iron parts rust in water, rain or steam unless painted.
fras.settings.rust_speed.tooltip: How fast exposed iron rusts. Normal: about three days in water per stage.
fras.inspect.burn_rate: Burning fuel at %s%% of the full rate
fras.inspect.exhaust_short: Not all the exhaust is taken: the heat exchangers are short or their outlet is full
fras.inspect.exchanger_short: At full power: exhaust it can’t condense vents at the cylinders
fras.inspect.governor_state: Speed %s RPM, balls at %s RPM, throttle %s%%
fras.inspect.vent_behind: An emergency valve or release behind the governor bypasses it
fras.inspect.governor_steam_only: Only throttles steam: this pipe carries something else
fras.inspect.damper_stuck: Stuck where it is: rusted through
fras.inspect.bellows_second: A second bellows on this firebox does nothing
fras.inspect.no_outlet: No outlet: connect a pipe on the far side
fras.inspect.cooled: Cooled: water %s / %s mB/s, works up to 128 RPM
fras.inspect.leaks: %s leak(s) on this network, losing %s mB/s
fras.rust.rusted_through: Rusted through: jammed. Scrape with an iron plate to repair
fras.rust.leaking: Leaking %s mB/s. Scrape with an iron plate to repair
fras.rust.stuck: Rusted through: stuck where it is. Scrape with an iron plate to repair
fras.rust.no_cooling: Rusted through: no cooling. Scrape with an iron plate to repair
tooltip.fras.creative_engine: Creative only. Turns its socket at the speed you set, whatever the load. Right-click to set it.
tooltip.fras.creative_engine.details: 0 to 256 RPM either way; it changes speed at 32 RPM a second. Its screen shows the torque and power it gives.
tooltip.fras.load_bank: Creative only. Draws the torque you set from its socket. Right-click to set it.
tooltip.fras.load_bank.details: 0 to 512 Nm. Its screen shows the speed and the power it takes.
tooltip.fras.creative_steam_source: Creative only. Gives steam on every face, up to the pressure and rate you set. Right-click to set them.
tooltip.fras.creative_water_source: Creative only. Gives water or hot water on every face at the rate you set. Right-click to set it.
tooltip.fras.creative_drain: Creative only. Takes any water, hot water or exhaust steam on every face, without limit.
tooltip.fras.creative_firebox: Creative only. Heats the boiler above or beside it at the rate you set, with no fuel. Right-click to set it.
fras.creative.steam_status: Giving %s mB/s; the network is at %s bar
